commands.name: environment_remove
commands.description: Removes a conda environment and everything in it, on Navigator's Environments page (the environment, Remove, Remove); Navigator's dialog must name it first.

args.name: name
args.meaning: The environment's name; not the root environment.

args.name: mode
args.meaning: Must be "ui": Navigator has no scripting.

example_requests: Get rid of the test environment
commands.precondition: The program has Accessibility, and Automation for System Events.

errors.name: ValueError
errors.when: an argument is invalid or mode isn't "ui" or "background"

errors.name: UIError
errors.when: a named element never appeared, Navigator's dialog didn't name the environment, or the result wasn't seen in time

errors.name: StateBlocked
errors.when: a Navigator dialog holds typed text or can't be cancelled, or another app came to the front; nothing more was done

errors.name: NotFound
errors.when: no environment has that name; nothing is done

known_gaps: Verified on macOS 15.6.1 with Anaconda Navigator 2.6.6 only, so it isn't known to work on macOS 26 or any other version.
It depends on English names and was tested only in English.

Navigator's environment rows have no names: the environment is searched for by name, its row pressed in the middle of the row's own frame, and the selection checked by name in Navigator's Remove dialog before anything happens.
On launch, Navigator's offer to update itself gets No, remind me later and its offer to sign in for AI help is closed; nothing is updated or signed in.
commands.confirm: Remove the conda environment <name> and everything installed in it?
